harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Created a locked-password opsbot account on both node1 and node2 (RHEL 7). Generated an ed25519 keypair for opsbot on node1 and installed the public key in opsbot's authorized_keys on node2, enabling passwordless SSH from node1's opsbot to node2's opsbot. Enforced key-only auth for opsbot specifically (not system-wide) via a `Match User opsbot` block in sshd_config on both nodes (PasswordAuthentication no, AuthenticationMethods publickey), verified with `sshd -T` and by confirming a password-only SSH attempt was rejected with "Permission denied (publickey)". Completed the mandatory restart protocol: captured boot_id/uptime baselines on both nodes, restarted node1 then node2 sequentially (never concurrently), confirmed each came back with a new boot_id, and re-verified sshd active, opsbot account intact, publickey-only policy still enforced, authorized_keys present, and live cross-node key-based SSH functioning after both restarts.
actions_performed: Checked OS and existing opsbot presence on node1 and node2
Created opsbot user with locked password on node1 and node2
Generated ed25519 SSH keypair for opsbot on node1
Installed opsbot's public key into node2 opsbot authorized_keys
Checked global sshd_config auth defaults on both nodes
Appended Match User opsbot block (PasswordAuthentication no, AuthenticationMethods publickey) to sshd_config on both nodes and validated syntax with sshd -t
Reloaded sshd on both nodes and verified effective config via sshd -T -C for user=opsbot
Verified key-based SSH from node1 opsbot to node2 opsbot succeeds
Verified password-based SSH attempt for opsbot is rejected (publickey only)
Captured boot_id/uptime baseline and opsbot/sshd health on both nodes
Restarted node1, polled until reachable, confirmed new boot_id, verified sshd/opsbot/publickey policy recovered
Restarted node2, polled until reachable, confirmed new boot_id, verified sshd/opsbot/publickey policy/authorized_keys recovered
Re-verified end-to-end key-based SSH from node1 to node2 opsbot after both restarts

sshd active, opsbot account present, effective sshd config still enforces passwordauthentication no / authenticationmethods publickey for opsbot after reboot
Captured boot_id 325732f1-... and active sshd plus opsbot presence prior to restart

evidence.requirement: node2 restart acknowledgement and changed boot identity
evidence.summary: Reboot command acknowledged, node became unreachable, then came back with new boot_id bc8c1ee8-... and fresh uptime, proving an actual restart

evidence.summary: sshd active, opsbot account and authorized_keys with node1's pubkey intact, effective policy still publickey-only, and live SSH from node1 opsbot to node2 opsbot succeeded post-restart
